Minimal-surface-area change in strict dependency order:

1) Change the DEFAULT_CACHE_DIR constant - this is the one-line core fix.
2) Update DataCache docstring to reflect the new default.
3) Add a path helper to path_utils.py for consistency with existing helpers.
4) Wire BENCHBOX_CACHE_DIR through DataFrameRunOptions.cache_dir in runner.py
   so the runner explicitly sets the cache directory rather than relying on
   the module-level default.
5) Register dataframe-data/ in DirectoryManager so it is created alongside
   datagen/, results/, and databases/.
6) Update existing test assertions to expect the new path.
7) Add a parity test that asserts SQL and DataFrame defaults share the same
   benchmark_runs/ root.
8) Full verification: fast suite, smoke run, confirm output appears locally.
description:
DataFrame and SQL benchmarks use inconsistent default storage locations:

- SQL: `./benchmark_runs/datagen/{benchmark}_{sf}` (project-local, CWD-relative)
- DataFrame: `~/.benchbox/dataframe-data/{benchmark}/sf_{N}/{format}/` (user home, global)

This creates a confusing asymmetry where raw source data lives locally but
format conversions cache globally. Both should default to project-local under
`benchmark_runs/` so that all benchmark artifacts live together and are easy
to find, inspect, and clean up.

The core fix is a one-line constant change:

    # Before (data_loader.py:63):
    DEFAULT_CACHE_DIR = Path.home() / ".benchbox" / "dataframe-data"

    # After:
    DEFAULT_CACHE_DIR = Path.cwd() / "benchmark_runs" / "dataframe-data"

Plus wiring through runner construction, DirectoryManager, and test updates.
